title: Development environments for cloud agents · Cursor

facts.fact: Cursor's changelog entry for release 3.4, which introduces development environments for cloud agents, is dated May 13, 2026.
Cursor states that builds that hit its upgraded layer cache run 70% faster.
facts.quote: Builds that hit the cache run 70% faster.

facts.fact: Cursor states that build secrets used in Dockerfile-based environment configuration are scoped to the build step and are not passed to the running agent's environment.
facts.quote: Build secrets are scoped to the build step and aren't passed to the running agent's environment.

facts.fact: Cursor states that each development environment has its own version history that users can review and roll back.
facts.quote: Every development environment now has its own version history that users can review and roll back.

facts.fact: Cursor states that admins can restrict rollback permissions on development environments to admins only.
facts.quote: Admins can also restrict rollback permissions to admins only.

facts.fact: Cursor states that an audit log captures every action team members take on development environments.
facts.quote: An audit log captures every action team members take on environments

facts.fact: Cursor states that egress and secrets can be scoped at the development environment level, and secrets configured for one environment are not accessible from any other.
facts.quote: Secrets configured for one environment aren't accessible from any other.

facts.fact: Cursor states that if an environment configuration fails, the environment defaults to a base image with clear warning signs so cloud agents keep running instead of immediately failing.
facts.quote: If your environment configuration fails, it will default to a base image with clear warning signs so that your cloud agents can keep running instead of immediately failing.

facts.fact: Cursor states that cloud agents and automations support multi-repo environments, where a single environment can be configured with all repositories an agent needs, with re-use across sessions.
facts.quote: You can configure a single environment with all the repositories an agent needs for its work, with re-use across sessions.
